valuation_details.registered_at: 2026-10-21, before any V result was computed
valuation_details.ev_observed: close x shares (issuer count on the split basis of the closes) + debt + finance lease liabilities - cash - short-term investments - long-term marketable debt securities - long-term investments; US GAAP operating lease liabilities stay out (their cost is inside operating income), IFRS 16 lease liabilities are debt; non-controlling interests are not adjusted
valuation_details.long_term_investments: investments whose returns sit outside operating income are netted from EV and left out of invested capital: a total tag (LongTermInvestments, else OtherLongTermInvestments), else equity securities at fair value + without a readily determinable fair value (or their combined tag) + equity-method investments; EV without this netting is shown as a sensitivity (amended 2026-10-21 before any V result: the first registration assumed them small, but they are 34-131bn USD at Amazon, Alphabet, NVIDIA and Meta)
valuation_details.finance_leases_untagged_at_balance_date: zero, flagged with the latest earlier value
valuation_details.debt: first complete recipe of fundamentals.DEBT_RECIPES at the balance date, plus short-term borrowings and commercial paper
valuation_details.ebit: operating income of the trailing twelve months; where it is not tagged, revenue - cost of revenue - R&D - SG&A
valuation_details.tax: straight line from the trailing effective rate (income tax / pretax within 0-35%; 決算短信 IFRS: pretax less net income; a filer that does not tag pretax income: net income + income tax) in year 1 to the statutory rate in year T; the terminal year at the statutory rate
valuation_details.base_rates: literature distributions not obtainable (2026-10-21): V history comparison reported as データ不足

funding_details.registered_at: 2026-10-21, before any F result was computed
funding_details.start_cash: cash + short-term investments at the latest balance date (long-term marketable securities and investments excluded)
funding_details.operating_cf: trailing four-quarter operating cash flow / 4, moved by the change in NOPAT from its trailing level along the Task 2 central and stress paths (year 1 in quarters 1-4, year 2 in quarters 5-8)
funding_details.investment: trailing four-quarter capital expenditure / 4 every quarter (investment continues); committed purchase obligations are shown, not added (they are paid through capital expenditure or operating payments)
funding_details.debt_principal: the latest maturity schedule known at the as-of time: remainder of the fiscal year and the next twelve months over quarters 1-4, year two over quarters 5-8 (a schedule older than the balance date is used as is when it is not older than the latest fiscal-year end; a schedule last tagged before that is stale and treated as missing, amended after the first F results); without a schedule, the current portion over quarters 1-4 and the rest in quarter 5, or all debt in quarter 1 where the split is not tagged (worst case for the window); commercial paper and short-term borrowings in quarter 1 (no rollover)
funding_details.lease_payments: finance lease (IFRS 16 lease) payments due in years one and two spread the same way (the same staleness condition); without a schedule, the current portion over quarters 1-4 and the rest in quarter 5
funding_details.excluded: dividends and buybacks (discretionary), new equity or debt (none), undrawn credit lines
funding_details.unevaluated: no trailing operating cash flow or capital expenditure, or a shortfall that appears only under the worst-case maturity assumption
funding_details.timing_sensitivity: each year's principal in its first quarter
funding_details.obsolescence_sensitivity: capital expenditure x 1.25 in the funding path; depreciation x 1.5 (useful life 6 to 4 years) on the operating margin
funding_details.boundary: the multiple of operating cash flow at which the deepest central shortfall is zero; the operating margin at which cash flow after capital expenditure is zero (NOPAT moves cash flow one for one)
funding_details.concentration: only disclosed values; companyfacts carries no customer dimensions, so concentration is not collected unless read from a filing
